title: Hesitation in this session
explanation: The customer already removed items from their cart during this visit, which usually signals indecision.
suggested_action: Show a reminder or a small incentive, such as a free-shipping threshold.

title: Uses the cart like a wishlist
explanation: This customer often adds items to the cart and then removes them.
suggested_action: Offer a 'Save for later' list and price-drop alerts.

title: Rarely completes purchases
explanation: This customer has a low purchase rate compared with how often they add items to the cart.
suggested_action: Offer a first-purchase incentive and show trust signals such as reviews and the return policy.

title: Browses a lot, buys little
explanation: Past activity shows many views and cart additions relative to purchases.
suggested_action: Highlight best-sellers and limited-time offers to shorten the decision time.

title: Product rarely sells
explanation: Few customers who add this product to their cart go on to buy it.
suggested_action: Review the product page, photos, reviews, price and stock availability.

title: Category converts poorly
explanation: Carts in this category are often abandoned or cleared.
suggested_action: Check category pricing, delivery options and competing alternatives.

title: Interested in this product but not buying
explanation: The customer viewed or added this exact product before without purchasing it.
suggested_action: Send a targeted reminder or a time-limited discount for this product.

title: Price may be a barrier
explanation: The price is high compared with the category average or the product's usual price.
suggested_action: Test a discount, a bundle or an installment option.

title: Price changed since last view
explanation: The price differs from what the customer saw when they last viewed the product.
suggested_action: Communicate price changes clearly and consider price-match messaging.

title: Large cart
explanation: The cart holds many items or a high total value, which increases hesitation.
suggested_action: Offer free shipping, payment plans or money-back guarantee badges.

title: Comparing alternatives
explanation: The customer looked at many products, categories or brands before adding to the cart.
suggested_action: Show comparison tools, similar items and clear differentiators.

title: Low purchase intent in this session
explanation: Session behaviour suggests casual interest, for example adding to cart without browsing.
suggested_action: Use exit-intent messages and email or push reminders.

title: Visit pattern
explanation: The customer is new or returns after a long gap between visits.
suggested_action: Use welcome offers and re-engagement emails.

title: Time of day or week
explanation: The cart was created at a time when abandonment is more common.
suggested_action: Schedule reminders and promotions around these hours.

title: Other factors
suggested_action: Review the customer's behaviour in more detail.
